lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Sierra Leone to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data from October 2015 represents spatial classification of food insecurity phases as a proxy indicator of drought-related food security impacts on the population.
